package ui

// SelectedText returns the focused text selection without touching the system
// clipboard. Passwords and unfocused controls never expose their contents.
func (c *Context) SelectedText() string {
 st := c.rt.states[c.rt.focused]
 if st == nil || st.editor == nil || st.editor.password { return "" }
 ed := st.editor
 a,b := ed.selection()
 return ed.buf.slice(a,b)
}
